item.title: aespa exude 'ATTITUDE' for 'Kill Blue' anime theme song — listen
item.description: 'ATTITUDE' the opening song for the TV anime Kill Blue premiering April on TV Tokyo, is a quintessential aespa anthem. The lyrics exude a fearless confidence —an unwavering declaration that "no one can break who I am" — all while moving at its own defiant pace. With a chorus that unleashes a surge of pure euphoria, the track’s striking beats and addictive melody are impossible to shake. Marking their first Japanese release since 2024’s Hot Mess, this song sets the stage for aespa’s bold return.

item.title: Google launches BTS Scavenger Hunt ahead of 'ARIRANG' release
item.description: As the countdown to BTS' fifth album ARIRANG approaches, Google has teamed up with the K-pop trailblazers to create an exciting digital activation for ARMY. The easter egg experience lets ARMYs test their knowledge of BTS through puzzles and trivia, earning member-specific rewards and 14 collectible cards showcasing the group’s handwritten tracklist art. Begin your quest by searching BTS on Google and click on the tiny nautical inspired icon that pops up on the bottom right corner of your screen

item.title: A1 announce return to Manila & Cebu this October as part of 'Love in the Philippines Tour'
item.description: British-Norwegian pop group A1 are making their much-awaited return to the Philippines, bringing their signature blend of nostalgia and pop charm back to Cebu and Manila this October. The beloved quartet — Paul Marazzi, Christian Ingebrigtsen, Mark Read, and Ben Adams — will perform in Cebu on 16 October at the Waterfront Cebu City Hotel & Casino, followed by a Manila show on 17 October at the New Frontier Theater.
